content.text:
5,912 of the permits Chicago issued in 2024 are currently marked suspended.

I got this from the City of Chicago Building Permits dataset (ydr8-5enu). I counted permits with an issue date from January 1 to December 31, 2024 and a status of "SUSPENDED". Each of the 5,912 records has a different permit number, so there are no duplicates.

Here is how all 2024 permits break down by status:
- Complete: 20,197
- Suspended: 5,912
- Expired: 1,932
- Active: 1,329
- Phased permitting: 101
- Cancelled: 8
- No status listed: 3,960

The dataset says status isn't recorded for every permit type. Some of the 3,960 permits with no status could also be suspended, so 5,912 may be slightly low.

FINAL ANSWER: 5912
